【原视频简介】
Can magic from anime actually exist in real life? In Witch Hat Atelier, witches cast spells not with mana, but by drawing with a special "magic ink." In this video, I decided to test the science behind it and recreate that exact ink using real chemistry!

By breaking down the clues from the anime—like the Silverwood tree and traditional ink formulation—I combined carbon, a natural binder, glycerin, and real silver powder to make a shimmering, functional ink. And to bring the whole thing to life, I set up a chemical reaction that makes the drawn spell look like it's literally bursting into flames.

Which anime magic or invention should I try to bring to life next? Drop your ideas in the comments below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell icon if you love anime science experiments.
metadata.title: 用真实化学复刻《魔女之旅》的魔法墨水
